THE DETAILS MATTER.

Credits
& sources.

Our logo

The Legacy Garage logo was supplied by the project team. Its original navy artwork is used in the site header and footer.

Reference photography

The burgundy 1968 Chevrolet Corvair photograph is by Don O’Brien, licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 2.0.

View the original source on Wikimedia Commons ↗

The image has been resized and cropped for the website. Some placements apply a color treatment. It shows a reference vehicle, not the Legacy Garage 26 restoration car. The source identifies the vehicle as a 1968 Corvair; no specific trim is claimed here.

The opening reveal

The opening comparison shows a blue restoration vision alongside a red as-purchased reconstruction based on the team’s photographs. Both were rendered with matching camera and lighting settings. The red model includes the car’s weathered paint, damaged light, dirty windows, and worn upholstery. These are illustrations; the blue car represents a vision for the project, not completed restoration work.

The interactive model

Corvair Anatomy is the existing interactive model project incorporated into this website. It includes 13 functional assemblies and 4,284 selectable model objects. Choose English or Chinese for the website and model together.

The model is a tool for structural learning. Its modeled details, dimensions, and exploded arrangement should not be treated as factory specifications or a verified workshop procedure.

The viewer uses Three.js, distributed under the MIT license.
